steps.name: Open builder
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Use **Build Itinerary** / **Edit Itinerary**.
steps.expect: The itinerary builder opens on **Set Visit Date**.

steps.name: Visit date and distant animals
steps.do: On **Set Visit Date**, pick a date on the Zoomobile summer route. On **Add Animals**, add **African Lion** and **Grizzly Bear**.

steps.name: Skip Zoomobile as attraction
steps.do: On **Add Attractions**, do not add **Zoomobile** as an attraction (leave it unselected).

steps.name: Add Zoomobile as transportation
steps.expect: **Add as Transportation?** appears with messaging that the Zoomobile will be used to reduce walking distance when bulk scheduling.

steps.name: Confirm transportation and finish
steps.expect: The itinerary saves successfully. **African Lion** and **Grizzly Bear** are on the plan but unscheduled.

steps.name: List shows transportation only
steps.expect: **Zoomobile** appears under **Transportation** and does not appear as an attraction entry from this path.

steps.name: Rebuild to place rides
steps.do: Open **Day Planner View** and click **Rebuild schedule**.
steps.expect: Feedback such as **Schedule rebuilt** appears. Animals are scheduled on the timeline.

steps.name: Transit ride pills
steps.do: Look for Zoomobile ride rows on Day Planner (timed pills with a station subtitle).
steps.expect: At least one Zoomobile transit ride appears with a from→to station subtitle.

steps.name: No manual schedule actions
steps.do: Inspect the Zoomobile transportation / transit row actions on Day Planner and List View.
steps.expect: Transit-mode **Zoomobile** does not offer the same manual **Schedule** / **Unschedule** controls used for ordinary attractions.

steps.name: Remove transit transportation
steps.do: Remove **Zoomobile** transportation from the itinerary (List View remove / section remove).
steps.expect: **Remove from Itinerary?** appears with message that remaining items will be rescheduled without it.

steps.name: Day plan after remove
steps.do: Confirm the remove, then check **Day Planner View**.
steps.expect: Zoomobile transit rides are gone and the remaining animal schedule updates without them.
